title: Shadow Mode Isolation / Decode Cache Leak Audit
head: 88520a3e0
what_happened: 28BR-S flagged shadow mode appeared to produce injection-like token distribution. 28BR-U confirms this was a command-flag mixup (--prt-sidecar-true-injection inadvertently included in shadow command), not a code-level graph leak.

code_audit.gate_condition: g_prt_sidecar_true_injection_enabled AND g_prt_sidecar_apply_enabled required to pass
code_audit.true_injection_path: creates delta_w via mmap/memcpy, computes delta_y=delta_w @ attn_inp, calls ggml_add(ctx0, native_out, delta_y), returns injected
code_audit.shadow_apply_call: prt_shadow_apply() called in pager hook for metrics only, no ggml tensor created or wired into graph
code_audit.static_state_carry: none — each process has fresh ggml_context and pager state

null_views_explanation.observed: null_views increments from ~1 to ~111 during generation across 24+ hook calls
null_views_explanation.cause: Pager hook called once per GGML graph build op per token. Not a single tensor view — is the count of NULL-hook-call events across ALL op events in the generation loop
null_views_explanation.not_a_bug: High null_views is expected behavior given pager hook called for all graph ops, not just attention layer ops
null_views_explanation.layer_not_activated_explanation: Pager hook called for all layer indices, not just layer 0. Most layers report layer_not_activated=1 because they don't match g_prt_sidecar_apply_layer=0 filter

instrumentation_summary.injection_canary: fires ONLY in true injection mode
instrumentation_summary.apply_shadow: fires in both observe and shadow modes during pager hook, for metrics only

root_cause_28br_s: Command-flag mismatch — --prt-sidecar-true-injection inadvertently included in commands meant to be shadow-only. The mutation path ISOLATED from shadow path at line 1317 gate.
safe_claim: Shadow mode is clean. No graph mutation occurs without --prt-sidecar-true-injection flag.
forbidden_claims: no quality, correctness, speedup, Q2→Q4 recovery, long generation, FFN/non-square, multi-layer/family, production readiness

next_recommended_phase.description: attn_out orientation/magnitude sanity — verify decoded residual orientation (should be [896×K]), scale magnitude, condition number, NaN/Inf check
